description.value: Quantitative brain MRI study examining effects of alcohol dependence and concurrent chronic cigarette smoking on regional brain volumes, and relationships between cognition and brain structure.

spans.text: These data provide preliminary evidence that comorbid chronic cigarette smoking accounts for some of the variance associated with cortical gray matter loss and appears to alter relationships between brain structure and cognitive functions in alcohol-dependent individuals.
